how: generated cells, copied whole — 12 of the 210 of `scripts/silent-sweep/d199/gen199.py`, kept WHOLE (both HOF shapes × all three `fld` legs × both `order` legs) because a partial composition's price is not collapsible. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/silent-sweep/d199/gen199.py /tmp/g199`, materialise with `python3 scripts/silent-sweep/d243/mkset.py /tmp/set scripts/silent-sweep/census/d351-halfroute-price.json /tmp/g199`.
note: THE PRICE OF A PARTIAL COMPOSITION (silent-class-inventory D351). D351 closed by folding two `$fnsig` pool entries whose functypes render byte-identically onto one type index. FOUR sites turn a pool position into a type index, and they must all resolve it the same way or a closure is DECLARED with one functype and CALLED at another — which is the very defect D351 is. These 12 cells RUN on every shipped compiler and are the tripwire for that: each of the two reachable half-routings takes all 12 from `runs` to `trap_loads`.
ablation: on the landing: 12 runs. With the DECLARED functype unrouted (rung D) the whole grid reads 198 runs / 12 trap_loads — IDENTICAL to the base histogram — while 24 cells have moved: these 12 lost and D351's own 12 bought. With the VALUE CALL unrouted (rung V) the grid reads 186/24 and these 12 are the loss. The arithmetic is invisible in the first case and only a cell-matched grade sees it.

d199_hof2_decl_i32_norm.why: THE PRICE OF ROUTING HALF THE POOL. `hof2_decl` is `Circle` (a union arm) beside a declared `Dot` of its layout, each closure meeting its OWN callee — so the two `$fnsig`s never have to agree and the program has run on every compiler. It stops running the moment the pool's twin is resolved at SOME of its four consumers and not the others: the callee is declared at the twin and the `call_indirect` names the raw position, or the reverse. Measured on the 210-cell D199 grid: `runs` -> `trap_loads` with the DECLARED type unrouted (D) and again with the VALUE CALL unrouted (V), 12 cells each time. Under the full landing all 12 run and the emitted bytes are unchanged.
d199_hof2_decl_i32_norm.also: already curated under `d199-rungs` as one of that set's six controls; kept in its original block and listed here because the SET this ablation named is all twelve, not the ten that were missing.
